name: MaloneX
description: WhatsApp bot built by Brian Malone

STORAGE.description: Storage backend: file or postgres. Postgres is selected automatically when DATABASE_URL starts with postgres://

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string (Heroku). Leave empty when using file storage.

DATA_DIR.description: Directory used for file storage and Baileys credentials.

OWNER.description: Owner phone numbers, comma separated, digits only (country code, no +).

PUBLIC_MODE.description: Allow non-owner users to run public commands.

PORT.description: Port for the web pairing server.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.

AI_API_URL.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint for AI commands and the chatbot.

AI_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for the AI provider.

MEDIA_API_URL.description: Optional Cobalt-compatible media download provider base URL.
